name: gofront
author: Luuk van Venrooij
description: A Go-inspired language that transpiles to JavaScript

scripts.build: node src/index.js example/simple/src -o example/simple/app.js && node src/index.js example/reactive/src -o example/reactive/app.js && node src/index.js example/gom/src -o example/gom/app.js && node src/index.js example/templ/src -o example/templ/app.js && node src/index.js example/webgl/src -o example/webgl/app.js
scripts.test: node test/unit/run.js && node test/e2e/perf/zero-alloc.js && node src/index.js test --dom example/...
scripts.check: biome check . && sentrux check && sentrux gate && node src/index.js check example/...
